label: Ear base height

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 5.4 #13 (rename of EarPlacementHeight; measurement family section 5.1, species values section 5.3: puma CT [D], rest [E])

range.endpoint_anchor: ear base height / L: 0.04 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.10 -> -100 = -0.06, +100 = 0.14 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.04) / 0.10)

region.mask_rule: ear part placement at the meatus pivot, vertical vs palatal line; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Height of the ear-base pivot (pinna insertion; skull proxy = centre of the external acoustic meatus) above the palatal line, as a fraction of L. Replaces EarPlacementHeight (spec section 5.4): the old unitless placement index had no physical anchor and its preset values do NOT carry over - the old index conflated pivot height with tip emergence, which now lives in EarTipHeight + EarTilt. The bony insertion barely varies across mammals (0.01-0.05 L, spec section 5.3); what reads as ear height in life is tip height + carriage. A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
